instructions: Answer with one complete, self-contained HTML file and nothing else.
output: evals/runs/<date>/<model>/<case>/<variant>.html; count with: npx tsx scripts/eval-markup.ts --runs evals/runs/<date>/<model>

variants.description: The prompt alone: no build-with-perfectui skill, no perfectui MCP server.
The build-with-perfectui skill at 1.0.0 (perfectui, branch feat/skill-1.0.0) and this server (node dist/server.js) connected.

cases.prompt: Build a login page with Perfect UI: a centered card with an email field, a password field, a "Remember me" checkbox, a primary "Sign in" button and a "Forgot password?" link.
Using Perfect UI, make a page that lists eight team members in a table with alternating row colours: name, role, email and a status badge that says Active or Invited.
With Perfect UI, make a project page with a "Delete project" button that opens a confirmation modal: a warning that it cannot be undone, a Cancel button and a red Delete button.
Create a notification settings form with Perfect UI: switches for email, push and SMS notifications, a select for the digest frequency, a checkbox to accept the terms and a Save button.
Build a pricing page with Perfect UI: three plans (Free, Pro and Team) side by side as cards, each with a price, a list of features and a call-to-action button, with the Pro plan highlighted.
Make a small dashboard page with Perfect UI that opens in dark mode and has a toggle to switch between light and dark: a header, two cards with a number each and a list of recent activity.
